name: Mixpanel Android SDK

dataTypes.when: Always: events you send with track(). If trackAutomaticEvents = true, also first open, app updated and session events.

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always. $device_id is an autogenerated device-local ID (UUID-based unless you supply a DeviceIdProvider); regenerated on reset().

By default. Mixpanel derives $city, $region and country from the request IP (IP is discarded after geolocation). Turn off with meta-data com.mixpanel.android.MPConfig.UseIpAddressForGeolocation = false.

ask: Do you call identify() with your own user ID? If yes, declare Personal info / User IDs.
Do you set People/profile properties such as $email, $name or $phone? If yes, declare Personal info / Email address, Name, Phone number accordingly.
Is trackAutomaticEvents = true? It also sends $ae_crashed with the crash reason: declare App info and performance / Crash logs.
Do you track revenue or purchases (e.g. trackCharge or purchase events)? If yes, declare Financial info / Purchase history.

Do you use Mixpanel Session Replay (com.mixpanel.android:mixpanel-android-session-replay)? It captures image snapshots of the UI (not video); input fields are always masked and text, images and WebViews are auto-masked by default; recordingSessionsPercent defaults to 100. If enabled, declare App activity / App interactions and review any unmasked views for personal data.

sources.title: Session Replay for Android - Mixpanel Docs

notes: Mixpanel does not publish a Play Data safety guide for Android; mapped from its SDK docs. Default event properties also include device model/manufacturer, OS, app version, carrier, wifi, bluetooth/NFC flags and screen size (device characteristics, not separate Play data types). Treated as service provider.
